checks.description: High-risk conversation events are written to the local review outbox before external dispatch.
n8n/webhook events use signed redacted envelopes and block PHI-like payload fields.
n8n templates are inactive by default and are optional scaffolds, not live clinical automation.
High-risk review alerts require synthetic test-recipient mode when external dispatch is enabled.
Channel delivery receipts are explicitly not treated as clinician acknowledgement.
Failed delivery attempts are retried with bounded attempts and then dead-lettered without losing the local alert.
Scheduled automation is documented as ready for scheduler/n8n, but no host scheduler is installed automatically.
The automation control plane queues redacted engineering jobs in dry-run mode and sends no webhooks while building artifacts.

channel_matrix.intended_use: Notify an internal demo/reviewer inbox that a redacted review item exists.
Optional short redacted engineering notification to a test maintainer number.
Optional internal demo channel notification for reviewer workflow visibility.
Primary source of truth for queued/notified/acknowledged review items.

automation_center_visibility_requirement.label: Local outbox status
automation_center_visibility_requirement.why: The dashboard remains the source of truth even when external channels are configured.

automation_center_visibility_requirement.label: Delivery receipt status
automation_center_visibility_requirement.why: Delivery status is transport evidence only and must not be confused with clinician acknowledgement.

automation_center_visibility_requirement.label: Retry/dead-letter visibility
automation_center_visibility_requirement.why: Operators need failure visibility without losing the local review item.

automation_center_visibility_requirement.label: Redaction/signature visibility
automation_center_visibility_requirement.why: Webhook safety should be inspectable before any optional n8n/email/SMS/Viber path is used.

automation_center_visibility_requirement.label: Claim-boundary visibility
automation_center_visibility_requirement.why: Automation must not make the product look clinically monitored or production-ready.

automation_center_visibility_requirement.label: Unacknowledged queue age
automation_center_visibility_requirement.why: Operators need stale-queue visibility while the UI must state that the threshold is not a clinical response commitment.

why_not_higher: No real clinical operations team is configured.
No real patient notification or emergency dispatch is permitted.
No compliance review, incident-response SLA, or clinician on-call rota exists.
External channels are optional scaffolds and disabled by default.

recommended_operator_steps_before_real_u: Complete security and privacy review for any real notification channel.
Define on-call ownership, escalation hours, and failure handling outside the app.
Obtain clinician workflow review and written operating procedure.
Keep PHI out of webhook payloads; use sign-in-required dashboard links only.
Run receipt and dead-letter drills before enabling any non-local notification.
claim_boundary: Automation reliability evidence is engineering evidence only. It does not prove emergency coverage, clinician receipt, patient benefit, clinical validation, compliance, or healthcare production readiness. All external notification channels remain redacted, test-recipient-only unless an operator deliberately configures them under a separate security and clinical-review process.
